products.description: Aluminum/composite cap and fascia boards; exterior trim accessory.

catalog_spec.marketing_blurb: Deck-out fascia, window heads, and rake details with a durable, paint-ready cap that sheds water better than raw wood returns.
primary_applications: Fascia and sub-fascia capping on eaves and rakes
Window drip caps and head flashing integration
Gable trim transitions where a rigid, low-maintenance cap is specified
typical_profiles: Drip-edge compatible profiles; color-matched coil often ordered separately
catalog_spec.coating_performance: Ask for coastal/salt-spray rated SKUs where within one mile of salt water.
catalog_spec.fasteners: Color-matched trim screws or stainless per manufacturer; pre-drill in cold weather.
catalog_spec.bundling: Sold per piece; job packs may be broken for LTL.
catalog_spec.storage: Store flat, dry, out of direct sun before install; stack tall bundles on dunnage.
catalog_spec.warranty_class: Manufacturer limited finish/substrate warranty; varies by series—quote exact SKU.
catalog_spec.hs_style_category: Exterior building trim / formed metal-composite trim

products.description: Bevel cedar siding; exterior spec and appearance grades.

catalog_spec.species: Western red cedar or incense cedar (grade line dependent—confirm on quote)
catalog_spec.marketing_blurb: Classic bevel lap with strong shadow line; spec-grade and appearance grades for paint, stain, or natural weathering.
primary_applications: Residential and light commercial cladding
Gable accents and feature walls
Historic-appropriate repairs where bevel lap is existing
nominal_sizes: 1×6", 1×8", 1×10" exposures vary by mill reveal—verify coverage
catalog_spec.moisture_content: Kiln-dried target 12–15% for exterior stock; acclimate on site per GC schedule.
catalog_spec.coverage_notes: Quote by square foot of wall area; add 8–12% waste for cuts and stagger.
catalog_spec.finish_guidance: Factory pre-stain available on some lines; field coat all six sides if painting.
catalog_spec.fasteners: Hot-dip galvanized or stainless ring-shank siding nails; blind-fasten where specified.
catalog_spec.storage: Keep strapped, off ground, under cover; sticker if loose-piled in humid yards.
standards_reference: Local wind load and nailing schedule per engineer of record
catalog_spec.sustainability: FSC/PEFC available as special order on some mills; lead time extends.

products.description: Cedar siding assortment; job-lot and stocking SKUs.

catalog_spec.species: Primarily western red cedar; may include Port Orford or Alaska yellow cedar on specialty pulls
catalog_spec.marketing_blurb: Job-lot program spanning bevel, channel, tongue-and-groove, and shingles/shakes-pull equivalents from regional mills.
primary_applications: Full cladding packages
Wainscot and porch skirt
Accent bands matching existing cedar architecture
catalog_spec.grading: Quote references exact mill tally; knotty vs clear varies sharply in price and lead time.
catalog_spec.unit_basis: Priced per covered square foot once profile and reveal are locked.
catalog_spec.custom_runs: Minimums apply on pre-primed or fire-retardant treated cedar—ask inside sales.
catalog_spec.compat_trim: Pairs with western red cedar trim stock, ABX caps, or composite jambs as specified.
catalog_spec.documentation: Mill certificates, grade stamps, and moisture certification available on request.
catalog_spec.freight_notes: Long packs may require extended trailers or piggyback unload by appointment.

products.description: Cedar dimensional lumber; various nominal sizes.

catalog_spec.marketing_blurb: Light, stable cedar for exposed rafters, pergolas, trim blocking, and exterior millwork cores.
primary_applications: Exposed structural accents rated for appropriate spans
Exterior nailers and outriggers in cedar assemblies
Posts and beams where natural decay resistance is desired (engineer-sized)
catalog_spec.unit_pricing: Board foot (MBF basis) with min charge on small picks.
catalog_spec.handling: Soft species—use wide carriers; avoid single-point slings on long lengths.
catalog_spec.field_notes: Seal end cuts in the field if priming schedule slips to reduce checking.

products.description: Douglas fir framing and appearance; studs and boards.

catalog_spec.species: Douglas fir–larch (DF-L) or Douglas fir south (region dependent)
catalog_spec.marketing_blurb: High-strength softwood for framing, industrial crating, and vertical-grain appearance where specified.
primary_applications: Studs, plates, headers (grade and stamp per plan)
Concrete forms and tilt-up bracing
T&G roof deck and industrial flooring in industrial grades
catalog_spec.moisture_content: Surfaced green or kiln-dried per stamp; match to indoor vs outdoor spec.
catalog_spec.unit_basis: Piece count on sticks; MBF on random-width tally.
catalog_spec.storage: Stickering green timbers if job holds more than two weeks in wet climates.

products.description: Preservative-treated furring and utility stock for exterior exposure.

catalog_spec.material: SPF/SYP furring strips; MCA or comparable treated formulation (retention by SKU)
catalog_spec.marketing_blurb: Ground-contact and above-ground retentions for strapping rainscreens, sleeper decks, and utility packs.
primary_applications: Vertical and horizontal furring over WRB
Concrete sleeper pads for low-clearance decks
Packaged barn/outbuilding kits
common_sizes: Custom rip from 2× stock by yard
catalog_spec.retention_notes: Match retention code (UC codes) to soil contact and species—quote tag on bundle end.
catalog_spec.fasteners: Hot-dip galvanized or stainless; avoid bright nails in treated interfaces.
catalog_spec.handling: Wet when fresh—allow surface dry before cladding; use dust controls when ripping.
catalog_spec.disposal: Follow local landfill rules for cutoffs; do not burn.
catalog_spec.warranty: Treater's limited warranty; job documentation requires end tags and invoices.

products.description: Furring/trim strips; interior packs and contractor counts.

catalog_spec.material: Kiln-dried SPF or hem-fir rippings; paint-grade
catalog_spec.marketing_blurb: Contractor-pack furring and small trim for shims, backing, and light finish carpentry.
primary_applications: Cabinet and built-in shims
Light gauge plaster/gypsum backing
Door jamb buildup where thin rips are needed
catalog_spec.bundling: Job packs of fixed lineal count; may be banded MRF.
catalog_spec.finish: Unprimed; pre-primed available as separate SKU at some branches.
catalog_spec.moisture_content: KD 14–16% typical; stabilize before fine paint work.
catalog_spec.quality_notes: Utility grade—expect wane and skip allowed per pack spec; inspect before stain-grade use.

products.description: Engineered floor and header members; vendor-specific depths.

catalog_spec.marketing_blurb: Designed floor and roof framing with predictable stiffness; shop drawings and supplier stamps required on structural packages.
primary_applications: Residential and multifamily floor systems
Long-span headers over openings
Roofs requiring consistent bounce control
catalog_spec.design_requirements: Loads, spacing, bearing length, and hanger schedule from engineer or vendor software output.
catalog_spec.moisture_service: Protect from ponding; OSB webs swell if left uncovered—house-wrap cutoffs over joist packs on site.
catalog_spec.field_modification: NO improper cuts in flanges; follow manufacturer bulletin for penetrations.
catalog_spec.documentation: Installation manuals, COA sheets, ICC-ES reports as referenced on plans.
catalog_spec.freight: Wide bundles may require flatbed with unload equipment; crane fees billed separately if applicable.

products.description: Miscellaneous contractor lumber line; mixed softwood stocking.

catalog_spec.scope: Blend of hem-fir, SPF, and SYP common sizes; yard-run convenience line
catalog_spec.marketing_blurb: Fast-pick dimensional for service crews, punch lists, and non-critical blocking where exact species is not specified.
primary_applications: Temp bracing and protection
Blocking and backing where plans read ‘wood nailer’ generically
Packaged small-job kits for remodelers
catalog_spec.grading: No. 2 & better or economy—tagged per lift; not for graded structural without re-inspection.
catalog_spec.unit_basis: MBF or per-piece yard price; no mill certification on mixed pulls.
catalog_spec.substitution_policy: Subject to inventory substitution within posted species envelope—confirm for exposed work.

products.description: Pre-matched primed SPF moulding and jambs.

catalog_spec.material: Finger-jointed or solid SPF; factory pre-primed white
catalog_spec.marketing_blurb: Pre-matched casing, base, crowns, and jambs for fast trim packages with consistent prime.
primary_applications: Residential trim outs
Light commercial offices
MDU punch where repeatable profiles speed close-out
catalog_spec.paint_system: Acrylic primer; topcoat with quality latex within 30 days of exposure rule set per painter TDS.
catalog_spec.joinery: Scarf or coped joints recommended; prime all end cuts.
catalog_spec.storage: Flat racks—avoid bowing by banding until install.
catalog_spec.quality_notes: Inspect for corner crush on long bundles before job start.

products.description: Ponderosa pine boards; craft and utility lines.

catalog_spec.marketing_blurb: Light-colored boards with mellow grain—popular for shelving, feature walls, and rustic interiors when clear grades are specified.
primary_applications: Wide-board paneling
Craft and fixture building
Economy shelving and workbench tops (appropriate grade)
catalog_spec.moisture_content: KD 10–12% for interior; exterior use requires coating discipline.
catalog_spec.workability: Softer than fir—use sharp cutterheads; pre-drill near ends for screws.
catalog_spec.sustainability: Regionally sourced Intermountain/West Coast; chain-of-custody on request.

products.description: Fir appearance grades; decking and fascia applications.

catalog_spec.species: White fir / grand fir group marketed as red/white fir in regional tallies (verify invoice species code at quote)
catalog_spec.marketing_blurb: Straight, relatively fine-textured fir boards suited to painted fascia, soffit nailers, and covered porch ceilings.

Protected porch ceilings with vented assembly
Interior stain-grade where tight grain preferred over SPF
catalog_spec.moisture_content: KD stock for interior; exterior—coat all faces prior to exposure.
catalog_spec.fasteners: Corrosion-resistant; set-back rules for decking profiles match WUD or county guide.
catalog_spec.ordering_note: SKUs may read 'RDF' or similar legacy codes; confirm grade stamp photo with buyer.

products.description: Select tie/manufactured pine assortments for packaged goods.

Dunnage and blocking for controlled specs
Component manufacturing where wane limits are published per bundle tag

products.description: Southern yellow pine / HF #2 dimensional and boards.

catalog_spec.marketing_blurb: High-density option (SYP) in many yards for stiff joists and decking cradles; HF variant for West Coast balanced inventories.

Deck joists on prescriptive decks
General utility blocking

products.description: Thermally modified decking/cladding; extended lead on some widths.

catalog_spec.marketing_blurb: Low-maintenance exterior wood aesthetic without chemical preservatives; ideal for premium decks, cladding, and fencing.

Rainscreen cladding with ventilated cavity
Feature soffits in coastal microclimates

catalog_spec.finish_optional: Natural graying expected UV; tinted oils renew color if desired.

products.description: Tongue-and-groove paneling and porch ceiling stock.

Shiplap-style feature walls
Gable-end accents

products.description: WRC boards, bevel, and clears; high rotation SKU.

catalog_spec.marketing_blurb: Flagship exterior spec wood—naturally durable, light weight, and available from knotty micro to clear vertical grain.

Fence boards and gates

products.description: Yellow pine boards and dimension for industrial and retail.

products.description: Fiberglass reinforced wall panels; commercial kitches and restrooms.

Healthcare ancillary wet rooms
Clean corridors in schools and stadiums
